card.name: Word completing a contrast pair
card.fires_on: Fires on the word that finishes one half of a contrast, such as non-fatal, non-pharmacologic, adults (after 'both'), human (after 'outnumber'), or land (after 'on', against sea).

modes.description: A noun that sits in an implied pair, such as adults and children, or land and sea.
